توايلت (form VI)
# تَوَايَلْتُ (tawāyaltu) /ta.waː.jal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَايَلَ (tawāyala)
# تَوَايَلْتَ (tawāyalta) /ta.waː.jal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَايَلَ (tawāyala)
# تَوَايَلْتِ (tawāyalti) /ta.waː.jal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَايَلَ (tawāyala)
# تَوَايَلَتْ (tawāyalat) /ta.waː.ja.lat/: third-person fem
